accuracy: Reference-guided approximate geometry; not pixel-perfect retail parity.
referenceInspection: Actual pixels inspected locally with view_image; media files stay outside the deliverable.

profiles.observed: Thin center circle and dot with four separated white diagonal strokes in a wide rectangle.
limits: Reference establishes this silhouette, not a pixel-perfect profile for every Roller or range condition.

profiles.observed: Center circle plus four solid chamfered/octagonal corner brackets. Brackets remain solid while the same weapon holds and launches its canopy.
profiles.statePolicy: Same solid silhouette irrespective of canopy presentation. The current seam does not distinguish launched from closed; no new classifier is invented.
profiles.implementationPolicy: A frozen spreadTickSvgs array decorates the existing four authoritative spread tick nodes in TL,TR,BL,BR order. Matched production captures on 8bfe6a00 showed a narrow horizontal outer extent +/-34 at --sp:0 versus inspected reference approximately +/-70. The corrected child path is M-46 -10V-20L-36 -30H-26, mirrored for other quadrants, in a centered104x80 viewport. Parent centers remain x +/-24 plus native horizontal --sp, y +/-24; child outer extents46/30 produce approximately70/54 at zero spread. Only child artwork moves, keeping authoritative parent transforms, node order, spread, color and visibility unchanged. This correction requires its own actual capture before visual acceptance.
limits: Destroyed/recovery states and exact per-model dimensions remain unverified; no dashed canopy state is fabricated. Final actual-HUD comparison is still needed; this child-artwork baseline correction alone does not establish retail parity.

profiles.referenceScope: Wiper identity and geometry are supported only by drive_1.gif and its extracted sequence grid. The separately named practice JPEG has unverified identity and is not evidence for this profile.
profiles.observed: A horizontal comb at idle changes to a vertical comb while charging and returns to horizontal on release. No circular progress gauge is visible.
profiles.statePolicy: charging must be the authoritative boolean true; otherwise idle wins even when a stale charge value remains. Full uses the same cached charge SVG.
limits: Exact full-charge timing, progress-color rule and final full-charge color are not established. Shape-only replacement inherits the existing native color owner, including target/feedback cues; no new palette or retail color-parity claim is introduced.

profiles.observed: Own same-weapon Stamper video shows four vertical idle ticks per side, a column of four horizontal charge bars above and below the center circle, and the horizontal idle comb restored on release. Charge outer bars visibly narrow. This is a separate silhouette from Wiper, not borrowed geometry.
profiles.activationPolicy: Active only for base catalogRecord.id s3-saber-normal; own verified sequence establishes the idle/charge/release silhouette, with approximate normalized dimensions.
limits: Normalized positions, bar widths and taper are approximate, not pixel-perfect. Static charged bars do not establish dynamic charge progress/fill fidelity. Exact full-charge color/timing and flashes remain unverified and no new color/progress/flash mapping is fabricated.

excluded.reason: Decavitator geometry has not been verified; do not generalize from Wiper/Stamper.
No new confirmed geometry profile implemented in this module; preserve legacy fallback.

implementationConstraints: Only presentation records are read; no physics, RNG, clocks, gameplay source parameters or weapon mutation.
All geometry inherits native currentColor; existing target/feedback color ownership is preserved and color parity is not asserted.
SVG strings and frozen profile/state records are created once at module initialization; selectors need no per-frame allocation.
All new classes use the iw-reticle-presentation prefix, apart from the compatible iw-ret__svg class.
SVG is centered with overflow visible and inline transform reset; all paths explicitly stay solid despite legacy far-range dashes.
Installer owns hidden legacy charge handles, sibling hit/kill ownership and unsupported-profile fallback.

Brella provides the same frozen four-string spreadTickSvgs array on profile and state; installer decorates existing spread nodes instead of adding a second marker frame. This module does not map spread values to screen positions.
